2023 Guide to apply for WSU:Digital Badge Program [Latest Guide 2023]

Are you looking for a way to enhance your overseas education experience and gain valuable skills that can boost your career prospects? If so, then you must not leave this opportunity provided by Wichita State University (WSU), which is a public research university located in Wichita, Kansas, USA. Whether you are a working professional or a student wanting to acquire multiple certificates/degrees, WSU has come up with their

“DIGITAL BADGE PROGRAM”

. This can be a benefit to add to your portfolio, and this is a not-to-miss opportunity for you who want to explore international education system by being at your own place.

Let’s get to know more about this program.

WHAT IS A DIGITAL

BADGE PROGRAM?

A badge program is a type of online learning that allows you to earn digital badges upon completion of certain tasks. A digital badge is a picture of your accomplishment.

This program can help you enhance your overseas education experience by providing opportunities to learn:

New skills

Explore different cultures

Develop your personal growth and

    What are the benefits of a DIGITAL BADGE PROGRAM?

    A badge program has many benefits for international students, such as:

    Flexibility:

    You can complete the badge courses online and at your own pace.

    Affordability:

    The badge courses are affordable and cost-effective.

    Quality:

    The badge courses are taught by experienced faculty who are subject matter experts in their fields.

    Recognition:

    The badge courses are part of your permanent academic record and will appear on your official transcript.

    Relevance:

    You can choose from a variety of badges that suit your interests and career goals, and which are relevant to your interest of learning.

      WHAT ARE THE BADGE PROGRAMS OFFERED BY WICHITA STATE UNIVERSITY?

      WSU offers over 70 badge courses in various disciplines, such as:

      ENGINEERING BADGES:

      These badges include topics listed below:

        Computer Programming

        Composite Structural Engineering Technology

          Optimization and root finding

          Focusing on your development of technical skills and your knowledge in engineering.

          BUSINESS BADGE:

          These badges cover topics such as:

          Professional writing

          Presenting online

          Professional correspondence etc.

          Helping in improving your communication skills and business acumen.

          HEALTHCARE BADGES:

          Topics covered by these badges are mentioned below:

          Medical terminology

          Anatomy and physiology of lactation

            ASL in healthcare settings

            And many more courses to choose from.

            BEHAVIORAL SCIENCES BADGES:

            These badges include topics such as:

            Introduction to Criminal Justice

              Achieving cultural competency

              NAAD specialty clinical certification and much more.

              And much more to boost your interpersonal skills and communication skills.

              GENERAL WORKFORCE SKILLS BADGES:

              The covered topics in this badge are:

              Age at work

              Origin at work

              CMFGT/CSET hands-on laboratory and many more.

              These badges can be helping you develop your personal growth, and cultural awareness skills.

                How do I enroll in a DIGITAL BADGE PROGRAM?

                To enroll in a badge program at WSU, you need to follow these steps:

                Find the badge or badges you are interested in from the badge catalogue.

                  To enrol and apply, follow the enrollment procedures

                  Add the badge to your course schedule and get going.

                  *Note: All the work must be completed by the last day of the semester.
